name: @prototype/materialization-api
description: Adversarial API prototypes for Epicenter materializations. Deliberately outside the root `workspaces` globs: it is a throwaway design artifact, not a package, and it must not enter the repo's CI gates. TypeScript and @types/bun resolve from the hoisted root node_modules, so `bun install` at the repo root is the only setup step. Verify with `bun test` and `bun run typecheck` from this directory.
